agentIdentity.registrySource: agent-registry-automation plus optional Microsoft Agent 365 package details

businessFunction: Assists licensed loan officers with credit decision recommendations by analyzing applicant financial profiles against institution lending criteria. Does not make autonomous lending decisions — all outputs require human review and approval before submission to the loan origination system.

underlyingModel.name: GPT-5 Chat
underlyingModel.benchmarkSummary: Reviewed benchmark and limitation sections from the Microsoft Foundry model card before production approval.

dataInputs: Applicant financial profiles including income, credit score, employment history, and debt-to-income ratio. Internal lending policy documents. Historical loan performance data (aggregated, no PII). Rate sheets and product eligibility matrices.
knownLimitations: 1. Model outputs are probabilistic — recommendations may vary across identical inputs. 2. Training data cutoff may not reflect current market conditions. 3. Model has no access to real-time rate feeds. 4. Cannot evaluate non-standard loan products not represented in training data. 5. Model performance may degrade for applicant profiles underrepresented in historical data.
stochasticBehaviorAcknowledgment: This agent uses a probabilistic foundation model. Outputs may vary across identical inputs. Stochastic behavior is disclosed per the 2021 Interagency RFI on AI, which discussed applying model risk management principles to AI/ML systems. This sample maps those principles to OCC Bulletin 2026-13 (formerly OCC 2011-12) / Fed SR 26-2 (formerly Fed SR 11-7) terminology; application to large language models remains an active area of supervisory guidance.

complianceManagerEvidence.scoreCaveat: Compliance Manager scores measure progress completing improvement actions and are not legal or regulatory determinations.

scoringRationale: Automated risk scoring on 2026-01-15. Score: 19/35 (Medium). MRM Tier assigned: Tier 2 - Enhanced MRM. Top scoring factors: Data Sensitivity (5/5 — processes applicant PII including credit scores and income) and Model Complexity (4/5 — GPT-5 Chat via Microsoft). Data sensitivity score confirmed by MRM officer review. Tier 2 assignment reflects Decision Support output type with Medium composite rating.
zoneWeightRationale: fsi_governancezone drives both fsi_score_userpopulation and fsi_score_regulatoryexposure using identical mappings (Zone 3=5, Zone 2=3, Zone 1=1). Flow 1 maps source fsi_agentinventory.fsi_zone into target fsi_modelinventory.fsi_governancezone. This double weighting is intentional: governance zone is the strongest single governance signal available at inventory time, reflecting both the breadth of user exposure and the intensity of regulatory examination applicable to that zone. This design choice is disclosed to examiners in this field on every scoring record.
sr117Pillar1Evidence: Agent Card documents model purpose, design rationale, data inputs, known limitations, model card review, and stochastic behavior per the solution's Pillar 1 model risk documentation requirements aligned to Fed SR 26-2 (formerly Fed SR 11-7) principles where applicable.
sr117Pillar2Evidence: Validation status: Validated. Last validated: 2026-02-15. Independent validator from Risk Management department confirmed conceptual soundness and ongoing monitoring adequacy, with Foundry evaluation evidence attached where available.
sr117Pillar3Evidence: Risk rating: Medium. MRM Tier: Tier 2. Governance zone: Zone 2. Three-lines-of-defense role separation: model owner (Consumer Lending), MRM officer / independent validator (Model Risk Management), auditor (Internal Audit).
